🐰✨ Détective Bunny — Chapter 1 is now available! ✨🐰

Hello everyone! 💖

I’m super happy to finally introduce you to the very first chapter of Détective Bunny, my brand-new story mixing investigation, action, comedy, transformation, and the kind of identity chaos we all love!

In this new series, you’ll follow Takeshi, a detective who is definitely not ready for the strangest night of his career… especially when his investigation throws him into an impossible situation with Nanami, a bunny girl as adorable as she is mysterious. Between neon lights, danger, panic, high heels, and body swapping, their adventure is only just beginning! 🌃💥👠

📖 Chapter 1 is available for free here!
But please note: only this first chapter is free.

The rest of Détective Bunny, along with many other stories, comics, and exclusive content, is available on my Patreon : patreon.com/u6375377
Pixiv: https://seyka83600.fanbox.cc/

So if you enjoy body swap stories, crazy investigations, glamorous heroines, and totally chaotic situations, I really hope this new series will be for you 🐰✨

I wish you a wonderful read, and I sincerely hope you’ll enjoy Détective Bunny as much as I enjoyed creating it! 💖

Thank you again for your support, your comments, and for being here 🙏✨

Hevn88 🐇💜
